summary: Staff can target a send to people confirmed on two newsletters, and an empty match sends to nobody.
detailed_changes: Added newsletter_segments: a newsletter plus a second newsletter the contact must also have confirmed.
Publish emails use that intersection when a post selects a segment, still dropping suppressed addresses.
An empty intersection completes the campaign with zero recipients.
affected_areas: Page or route: /staff/newsletters, staff post email campaign
User groups affected: staff editors; confirmed subscribers
Public impact: segmented sends only reach the overlap
Internal impact: channel-list sends stay unchanged when no segment is selected
